summary: Short kerb stretch where cars park, but apartments sit 13 m away.

best_section.where: Foxton Street east kerb, just south of the junction

drivers.seclusion: Apartment block 13 m away on the same side, more flats nearby; dense urban.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside lane with parked cars; a van fits only if a space is free.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street near a junction; some through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs, though a passenger loading zone sign sits nearby.

flags: Loading zone sign 11 m from kerb line
sun_shade: Open kerb; trees to the south-east give some morning shade.
